race.comment: ZEPHYR SONG (10) is having her first run for the new stable but should find this easier than what she faced down south. Revved up for this with a recent trial placing and can run a big race while fresh. DRACARIAN (1) has gotten better with each run this time in work and looks to be working up to a maiden victory. Include with the 2kg claim. LYRICAL GANGSTER (3) has been well in the betting in both starts to date and where there's smoke there's fire. Top-three commodity. MARKHAM MISS (8) was a touch disappointing last time out but the form prior was good enough for a race of this calibre. Watch for sharp improvement. TOSCANELLA (12) best of the rest from the low draw.
